rules.small_charter_9_or_fewer_seats: FAA public use + qualifying pavement supports only preliminary feasibility; no operator authorization or actual transport service implied.
rules.scheduled_more_than_9_seats: Part 139 AOC review required as applicable for scheduled air-carrier passenger operations, subject to exceptions such as Alaska.
rules.unscheduled_31_plus_passenger_seats: Part 139 AOC generally required; exceptions must be reviewed.
rules.atr42_scheduled: Not cleared by current data; review Part 139 Class I and performance.
rules.cargo: Flight-specific operator and airport access evidence needed; no blanket grant from public-use status.
rules.code_resolution: FAA LID is official national identifier, never automatically ICAO/IATA.
rules.all_airports: Manual owner approval and actual aircraft suitability required before game deployment.
